incidents.vendor_scope: Capture timestamps and normalized timestamps affected; no offset correction is known.
incidents.treatment: Exclude every overlapping M1 observation; also exclude BBO/order/event reductions through the first subsequent clean same-source M1 anchor. Keep original raw metrics and receipts.

nontrade_treatment: Reported A/C/M/F/R/N labels are diagnostic only until the exact source edition is proven corrected. T-only executed volume remains unchanged.

trusted_trade_admission.vendor_statement: All action T records are correct, even if identical to the previous action T record; historical non-T action/price/size labels remain uncertified.
